title: should open the mobile drawer via the hamburger and close it with the X button
verifies: below 768px the desktop rail hides, the hamburger opens a drawer populated with nav links, and the X button closes it

title: should navigate to Logs from the drawer and auto-close it
verifies: clicking the Logs link inside the drawer navigates to the Logs page and the route watcher auto-closes the drawer

title: should expand the Data group inline on mobile and navigate to Streams
verifies: the Data group expands as an inline submenu (no hover flyout) and the Streams child navigates and auto-closes

title: should close the drawer when tapping the overlay scrim
verifies: tapping the overlay scrim closes the drawer via interact-outside

title: should close the drawer when pressing Escape
verifies: pressing Escape closes the drawer via the escape-key-down handler
